description: Occurrence: the outcome acknowledgment (ADR 0012, "Acknowledging outcomes", Hub #782). The core, and only the core (`bunny/core`), tells a module that it recorded one of its outcomes, after it committed the outcome and its `(source, id)`, and again for each exact duplicate. It travels on `bunny.event.outcome-recorded.<module>`, where `<module>` is the last segment of the outcome's source, and its envelope subject is the outcome's message `id` (validator). A module's outbox forgets the outcome only when the sender is the core and `source` is the module's own; a lost acknowledgment is recovered when the module sends the outcome again at its next start.
